subject: organic
question: 有机化学·自由基极性：根据 Radical Learn 所采用的常见反应性分类，Piperidin-1-yl (aminyl) radical 通常主要表现为亲核型还是亲电型自由基？（回答该教材中的主要倾向，具体反应条件可能影响表现。）
explanation_en: N is more electronegative than C (3.04): aminyl radicals are electrophilic and aminate electron-rich arenes. Protonated, as aminium radical cations, they are more electrophilic still.
